name: Tahcia
description: MCP Server for browser automation — record, replay, and debug multi-tab Chrome workflows

tools.name: init
tools.description: Initialize a Tahcia session. Opens Chrome and attaches to the Tahcia console extension. Returns a sessionId (session:password) used by all subsequent tools. The user must already be logged in to the Tahcia console.

tools.name: record
tools.description: Start recording a new browser workflow. Every interaction the user performs will be captured as script steps.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: pause
tools.description: Pause recording temporarily. Use this when you need to perform actions that should NOT be recorded (e.g. typing a password, solving a CAPTCHA). Supply a note — it will be surfaced at this point when the script runs later, so the agent knows why execution paused.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

note.description: Reason for the pause, shown at runtime when the script hits this step

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resume recording after a pause.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: note
tools.description: Attach descriptors to current recording session. Must be called before stop()

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

long_summary.description: summarize what this this script does and its purpose

note.description: Tell future yourself how you need to call this script. From note on login, checking elements, etc. Note must be thorough so you don't get blind when reusing this script.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stop recording and save the workflow as a script. Returns the script hash which can be used with run (e.g. pass '@me/<hash>' to run).

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: script_get
tools.description: Fetch the full JSON definition of a saved script. The JSON includes a 'code' array of steps and 'screenshots'. You can inspect or modify fill/type values, or turn them into vars like vars:{varName:'hi'}  'echo $varName' references. Use the hash or script name without the '@me/' prefix.

tools.name: script_update
tools.description: Save an updated JSON definition back to a script. Only 'code' and 'screenshots' fields are used — pass the full object returned by script_get with your changes applied. Do NOT refactor or restructure unnecessarily; only change values that need to change.

json.description: The full script JSON from script_get with your changes applied

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a saved script. Pass the full script reference including the '@me/' prefix (e.g. '@me/abc123'). The script runs line by line; if it hits a pause step the note will be returned so you know what manual action is expected.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: continue
tools.description: Continue running the currenlt paused script

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Send a raw Tahcia command and return all text output. Use this for one-off commands not covered by other tools.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the currently active Chrome tab. Returns a PNG image.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: elements
tools.description: Return a structured map of all interactive elements visible in the current Chrome tab (buttons, inputs, links, etc.) with their coordinates and XPath selectors.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in a new Chrome tab and assign it an alias for later reference.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tabName.description: Short alias for this tab (used in subsequent commands)

tools.name: js_click_at
tools.description: Click an element in the active tab using normalised (0.0–1.0) coordinates relative to the viewport.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: mac_mouse_click
tools.description: Click Mouse Left Button

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

x.description: Absolute X pixel coordinate in the browser window

y.description: Absolute Y pixel coordinate in the browser window

tools.name: mac_click_and_type
tools.description: Click (mac) a position in the active tab then type text into it.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

x.description: Absolute X pixel coordinate in the browser window

y.description: Absolute Y pixel coordinate in the browser window

text.description: Text to type into the element

tools.name: mac_key_enter
tools.description: Press the Enter key (mac).

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: mac_mouse_move
tools.description: Move the desktop cursor (mac) to an absolute pixel position within the browser window.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

x.description: Absolute X pixel coordinate in the browser window

y.description: Absolute Y pixel coordinate in the browser window

tools.name: mac_mouse_drag
tools.description: Simulate a mouse drag  (down → move → up) between two absolute pixel positions. Useful for sliders, CAPTCHA challenges, and drag-and-drop interactions.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

tools.name: js_scroll
tools.description: Scroll a specific element (by XPath or CSS selector) to an absolute scroll offset.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

selector.description: XPath or CSS selector of the element to scroll

tools.name: js_scroll_at
tools.description: Scroll the element at a given viewport coordinate to an absolute scroll offset. Use when you know the position but not the selector.

sessionId.description: The session:pass string returned by init

x.description: Absolute X pixel coordinate of the scrollable element

y.description: Absolute Y pixel coordinate of the scrollable element
